## Maker Lab, Closed-Source & Open-Source Projects
- [Smart Companion & Smart Core (Smart Glasses Control Suite)](https://github.com/vodacthe/smart_companion) [Closed Source]: Closed-source paired Android ecosystem enabling smartphones to act as a low-friction remote control, HUD bridge, and file manager for Smart Glasses, Android TVs, and tablets.
- [AR Air Mouse — Hands-Free Gesture Cursor for AR Glasses](https://github.com/vodacthe/ar_air_mouse) [Closed Source]: Closed-source spatial interaction app that eliminates reaching for a phone screen while wearing AR glasses by converting subtle head motion and natural micro-gestures into a virtual pointer.
- [Decal Unwrap — Browser 3D-to-2D True-Scale Cut Template Engine](https://decal.vdthe.com/) [Open Source]: Turns painted regions on 3D printable models into millimeter-accurate 1:1 flat paper templates to print, cut, and wrap physically around 3D prints.
- [FaceTrack 6-DoF — Android Head Tracker for Simulators](https://github.com/vodacthe/face_track) [Open Source]: Low-latency 6-Degrees-of-Freedom (X/Y/Z translation + Yaw/Pitch/Roll rotation) camera head-tracking for flight, racing, and space simulators.
- [vdt-sys-agent — Zero-Dependency Linux Hardware Telemetry Agent](https://github.com/vodacthe/vdt-sys-agent) [Open Source]: Lightweight, one-line-install Linux server monitoring agent feeding real-time node metrics into the VDT Enterprise dashboard without pip or external runtime bloat.
